( astrology 101 )

The cheat sheet

How to read a chart

the four ingredients, in one sentence each

✦ Planets = what

Each planet is a part of you: your feelings, your love style, your drive.

✦ Signs = how

The sign shows the flavour that planet has. Venus in Leo loves loudly, Venus in Virgo loves through helping.

✦ Houses = where

The house shows which area of life that energy plays out in, like career, home or friends.

✦ Aspects = conversations

Angles between planets. They show which parts of you work together and which ones argue.

Put it together: "Moon in Cancer in the 4th house" means your feelings (Moon) are caring and protective (Cancer), and they show up most at home and with family (4th house).
